permissions.camera: Stowline uses the camera when you photograph bins, damage or paperwork, or scan a label.
permissions.photos: Stowline opens your photos when you choose one to add to an item, bin or container.
permissions.photosAdd: Stowline saves labels and images you export to your photo library when you ask it to.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Stowline will reopen your workspace as soon as you are back online.
offline.banner: No connection. Your changes are kept on this device and sync when you are back online.
